payload.posture: Read Matthew 27:62–66 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states chief priests and Pharisees recall Jesus’ rising claim, ask Pilate to secure the tomb, seal the stone, and post a guard. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
